Jobs fetch brief

Recorded 9 Nov 2026 from your Q&A answers. Status: Approved and fetched, 9 Nov 2026

Decisions

Accuracy ruleScraper only. Every value is copied exactly as the job board or posting states it. No assumptions, inference, guessing or filling gaps. Anything not stated is left blank.
ScopeAll jobs on every company's job board. No title filter.
Reject rulesNone applied: every title and every language is kept. Your keyword and reject lists are kept on file below but not applied.
FreshnessEverything currently open, any posting date. Posted date shown when the board provides it.
SourcesEverything possible: ATS feeds (141 companies), company-site careers pages opened in a browser (103), and job-site listings where readable (37). LinkedIn job listings are not fetched: LinkedIn blocks automated reading and its terms prohibit it.
Missing infoLeft blank when the posting doesn't state it. Work Setup, Country and Work Authorization are set only when the posting's own fields or text state them explicitly.
DropdownsFilters above the jobs table: Work Setup (Remote / Hybrid / Onsite), Country (ISO country list), Work Authorization (Required / Not Required / Visa & Relocation Support).
Multi-country jobsOne row; all countries listed; the country filter matches any of them.
SalaryAs posted: currency, amount or range, and period (a year / a month; hourly kept as hourly).
RefreshOne-time fetch after approval; refresh on request.
